title: Score de risque d'asthme pédiatrique (PARS)
formula:
The PARS is derived by summing the selected points:

| Variable | Points | |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Parental asthma | No | 0 |
| Yes | 2 | |
| Eczema before 3 years of age | No | 0 |
| Yes | 2 | |
| Wheezing, apart from colds | No | 0 |
| Yes | 3 | |
| Early wheezing 1 (before age 3 years) | No | 0 |
| Yes | 3 | |
| SPT + 2 to ≥2 aero- and/or food allergens | No | 0 |
| Yes | 2 | |
| African American race | No | 0 |
| Yes | 2 | |

1. Defined as present if the parent reported any wheeze in the last 12 months at the age 1-, 2- and/or 3-year exam.
2. Defined as present if the allergen wheal was ≥3 mm greater than the saline control.

how_to_use.why:
- L'un des systèmes de score prédictif les plus couramment utilisés pour l'asthme dans l'enfance.
- Plus sensible que l'[Asthma Predictive Index (API)](nabda:calc.asthma-predictive-index-api) et plus performant chez les enfants présentant un risque léger à modéré de développer un asthme (une cohorte souvent la plus difficile à stratifier sur le plan du risque).
how_to_use.when: Use in children aged ≤3–4 years presenting with wheezing episodes.
how_to_use.pearls:
- Based on an epidemiologic study of 762 children born to atopic parents.
- Study population was examined annually from ages 1–4 and again at age 7, when an objective evaluation for asthma was performed.
- Children were defined as having asthma if both of the following were present:

 - Parent reported asthma symptoms (tight or clogged chest or throat in the past 12 months, difficulty breathing or wheezy after exercise, wheezing or whistling in the chest in the past 12 months, or a prior doctor’s diagnosis of asthma).
 - Child demonstrated either significant airway reversibility (>12% increase in FEV1) or a positive methacholine challenge.
- Overall sensitivity is modest (68%), with good negative predictive value (93%).

next_steps.advice:
- Ce score n'a pas de valeur diagnostique pour l'asthme.
- Les résultats peuvent étayer les discussions avec les parents concernant le risque qu'un enfant développe de l'asthme et la nécessité d'une surveillance rapprochée.
- Il n'existe actuellement pas de consensus dans la littérature concernant une stratégie optimale de prévention primaire.

more_info:
Interpretation:

| PARS | Risk of Future Asthma | Risk of Asthma by Age 7 Years |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0-4 | Low | 3-11% |
| 5-8 | Moderate | 15-32% |
| 9-14 | High | 40-79% |
